name: Space Funeral: Of Rubies and Gold
summary:
Made in occasion of Space Funeral's 8th anniversary, this is a Space Funeral fangame that takes place during the first game's time, but with different main characters.

This story takes place in the wicked world of the claustrophobic caverns in the outskirts of Space Funeral. Everything has been transformed, and the perfect beauty of the world was lost. As Phillip and Leg Horse sweat and bleed on their quest, other legends are formed.

Follow the tale of Otton, Ghoul from Skull Village, and his adventure inside the Treasure Grotto to find a fix to his insatiable hunger for gold...
Will he be able to achieve what he desires?
